properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 5 at 3:58PM MST until November 6 at 4:00PM MST by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding continues along the Rio Grande and low-lying areas
in and around the Conejos River confluence.

* WHERE...East Central Conejos County in south central Colorado...
West Central Costilla County in south central Colorado...
South Central Alamosa County in southeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 400 PM MST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Low-water
crossings are inundated with water and may not be passable. Expect
many areas of slow moving or standing water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 356 PM MST, Flood waters continue to move downstream along the
Rio Grande, Conejos River and other tributaries. Flooding and
inundation of low-lying areas continues in the warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Alamosa East and Lasauses.
- http://www.water.noaa.gov
